nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is a young woman with a balanced figure and delicate features, slightly pale from illness but with a firm, sharp gaze, long black hair usually tied into a neat high ponytail, dressed in a simple and capable professional outfit such as a white shirt paired with dark trousers.
<Subject 2> is a young man, around 178 cm tall, with a moderate build and regular features but a shifty gaze, short neatly groomed hair, dressed in business casual attire such as a polo shirt or shirt with casual trousers, with a clean-shaven face and no facial hair.
<Subject 3> is a young woman with a pretty face but a gaze that often carries calculation, a slender figure, long wavy brown-dyed hair, dressed in fashionable women's clothing and fond of wearing dresses.
<Subject 4> is a cinematic wide establishing shot of a stylish modern coffee shop on the ground floor of a glass office tower in a commercial district, viewed from a far distance, vast open interior space visible through floor-to-ceiling windows, warm amber and golden interior lighting spilling softly onto the surrounding pavement, sleek minimalist furniture arranged in deep spatial layers receding toward the back wall, polished concrete floor with subtle reflective sheen, long clean sightlines extending deep into the room, soft diffused light with gentle falloff, shallow depth of field, film grain, cinematic color grading, warm tonal palette of browns, brass, cream and soft orange, contemporary architectural details, calm static atmosphere, no people, no figures, unobstructed distant perspective, strong environmental depth and spatial clarity, photorealistic cinematic still, shown in <Picture 4>.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows a tense confrontation inside <Subject 4>. <Subject 1> stands beside a dark wooden table near the window facing <Subject 2> and <Subject 3>, her hands clenched into fists at her sides, while <Subject 2> sits on a low-backed seat shielding <Subject 3> behind him and glares back at <Subject 1>. <Subject 3> cowers behind <Subject 2>, only half of her face and one shoulder visible, avoiding <Subject 1>'s gaze. <Subject 1> speaks one line of angry questioning; no one else speaks.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> fully_preserved - the young woman with the neat high ponytail, pale delicate face and sharp gaze in the white shirt and dark trousers is retained.
<Subject 2> fully_preserved - the young man with the short neatly groomed hair, clean-shaven face and business casual polo shirt and casual trousers is retained.
<Subject 3> fully_preserved - the young woman with the long wavy brown hair and fashionable dress is retained.
<Subject 4> weak_reference - style, color palette, lighting mood and material texture of the coffee shop are guided by the reference, while the actual background adapts to the shot's narrative.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic live-action style with shallow depth of field, film-grade color grading, and warm amber interior light balanced against cooler window light.
[Shot 1] A medium shot from an over-the-shoulder position behind <Subject 3>'s right rear frames all three figures together: <Subject 3>'s back occupies the right foreground, <Subject 1> (S1) stands at the left-center of the frame facing the camera directly, and <Subject 2>'s left-side back appears at the lower right. <Subject 1>, the young woman with the neat high ponytail, pale delicate face and sharp gaze in the white shirt and dark trousers, stands beside a dark wooden table near the window of <Subject 4>, her body turned toward screen-right where <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> are positioned, both hands clenched into fists at her sides, her weight leaning forward, her chin slightly raised as she demands an answer. The camera holds the medium shot with a subtle handheld drift as she says, her voice rising with fury, <d>[Chinese] 时辰，你什么意思！</d> Her eyes stay locked forward, burning toward the pair on the right side of the frame.

overall_soundscape:
Soft coffee shop ambience continues throughout with the low murmur of distant conversation and the faint clink of cups and saucers; the café's background music plays as a light, indistinct instrumental bed. A chair shifts once with a small scrape as <Subject 2> adjusts his protective posture.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.
